title: COMET: A coordinated multi-layer runtime monitoring framework for human-supervised AI-enabled safety systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.29816v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Incorporating AI systems into safety systems requires monitoring to avoid silent faults and ensure safe and reliable operation. Single monitors often do not provide actionable information for human supervisors, who act as the system's adaptive controller. We present COMET, a coordinated multi-layer runtime monitoring framework for human-supervised AI-enabled safety systems in which each monitor is anchored in a different fault mode. Monitor outputs are combined in a coordination layer and mapped by a communication layer to a traffic-light display. In this work, COMET consists of three monitoring layers: signal integrity, physics consistency, and the AI system's competence envelope. The framework is evaluated on an open dataset of compressed-air leaks, where an AI system detects leaks from acoustic emissions, with held-out conditions simulating covariate shift, semantic shift, and sensor faults, events expected during runtime but unknown

translated_title: COMET：面向人类监督的AI安全系统的协调多层运行时监控框架
translated_abstract: 将AI系统融入安全系统需要进行监控，以避免隐蔽故障并确保安全可靠的运行。单一监控器通常无法为人类监督者提供可操作的信息，而人类监督者扮演着系统自适应控制器的角色。我们提出了COMET，一个面向人类监督的AI安全系统的协调多层运行时监控框架，其中每个监控器都锚定于不同的故障模式。监控器的输出在协调层中进行组合，并通过通信层映射为红绿灯式显示。在这项工作中，COMET由三个监控层组成：信号完整性、物理一致性以及AI系统的能力包络。该框架在一个压缩空气泄漏的开放数据集上进行了评估，其中AI系统通过声发射信号检测泄漏，并使用保留条件模拟协变量偏移、语义偏移和传感器故障等运行时预期发生但事先未知的异常事件。
tldr: COMET框架通过协调信号完整性、物理一致性和AI能力包络三个监控层，为人类监督的AI安全系统提供红绿灯式的直观运行状态显示，有效应对运行时的各类未知异常。
en_tdlr: COMET is a coordinated multi-layer runtime monitoring framework that integrates signal integrity, physics consistency, and AI competence envelope monitors to provide traffic-light displays for human supervisors of AI-enabled safety systems under runtime anomalies.
